items.note: N1 states the copy/gather/scatter/side-injection network, the map (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) over three stages and restoration of arbitrary scratch, matching Lemma lem:scalar-motifs (728-739); N1.1-N1.2 follow the proof's route (net change independent of scratch, then (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), 742-764). What is missing: h=100, indexing by triples, the neighbour rules, and the actual coefficient check (central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2 or (|S cap T|-1)/2, with the side wires cancelling the rest, 752-759). The method only gestures at 'intersection-size coefficients', and the wire counts (767-783) are absent.

N2 gives the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, with edge operator D_vD_u^{-1}, so that only endpoint frames matter. Its method (stored = frame applied to the logical array, and a common frame commutes with a pointwise linear gate) is exactly the invariant argument of 804-817. The per-route sign form eps_w D_sink D_source^{-1} is only paraphrased.

N3/N3.1 correctly state nested nondegenerate labels in F^{tensor 3} built from triple indicators, with the only decreasing edges being the central wires 3->4, each losing h (997-1000); N3.2 gives the ratios 100/539 and 101/539 < 1/2 (1105-1110). But the budget sum |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich is replaced by the loose 'below W m'. The method only outlines the route: missing are the orthogonality of neighbouring triple lines (869-870, 953), the telescoping of signed changes to Wm-2N (1066-1071) and the F_2 orthonormal bases (1073-1102).

N4 states W_b XOR wires, the role permutation, P_U at gates and sinks and -P_{U_a} at X_a sources, the endpoint identity = I_m and s_b < W_b m. N4.1's deficit N-2L_b is equivalent to s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b, and N4.2 reproduces 1169-1171. But the method says every edge difference has rank equal to its dimension change, and it omits the N exceptional source edges, 2P_{U_a} of rank one where the dimension change is zero (1162-1166). That step is exactly what turns -2N into -N.

N5 has the right structure: one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, s_c < W_c m, telescoping to C^{tensor m}, and the 27k inverse factors fixed by C=iZC^{-1}Z (1291-1314). But the frame is given as the phase i^{wt(P_U x) mod 4}, without the Hadamard conjugation C_U = H^{tensor m} diag(...) H^{tensor m} (1193), and the count s_c = W_c m - 2N + 2L_c is not given. The derivation therefore skips the H diag(1,-1) H = X step that turns the character into the translation X_v (1254-1257).

N6 states that both relative deficits exceed 20*2^{-50}, hence s/W < m^tau with tau = 1-2^{-50} (1331, 1341-1343), and N3.2/N4.1 supply L<N/2 and s<Wm. The explicit eta_b, eta_c values (1319-1325) and the log m < 20 step giving m^{1-2^{-50}} > m(1-eta) (1332-1338) are absent. N6 is a bare inference, so this is not shown as derived.

T1/T2 state the O(V) digit split/merge, digit move, cyclic row split and controlled shift / unit scaling, with the paper's proofs: aligned streams after splitting on a digit (514-527), splitting the blocks at Q-a and merging in the opposite order (575-580), and c increasing pieces (592-604). The statement drops the hypothesis that the offset be preparable in b^{O(1)} time, the prime / denominator conditions, and the two-digit permutation.

The plan states A = E_1 Pi E_2 with lower-triangular E_i and a partial permutation with a ones, and that the shear costs exactly a H-D interchanges plus O(V). Both proofs follow the paper: topmost row and rightmost pivot (1376-1391); transform D by E_2 and H by E_1^{-1}, add Pi D, undo, one interchange per pivot (1432-1446). The choice of the fixed prime q avoiding denominators (1413-1423) is left implicit.

All parts of the paper's proof are present: the cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, Phi_{A_e} on every edge by recursive interchanges, the endpoint matrices giving H<-H+D on every row, the three shears D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D, the recurrence F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) solved to O(e^tau), and the fixed-tape parking schedule at O(V) per node (1491-1615).

The statement matches Lemma lem:chunk-swap. The steps follow the proof: peel and join the top rho digits into a row field of range >= W^k, pad to a multiple of W^k, take base-m pieces giving a geometric sum O(Ve^tau), and pad [2^u] to [q^e] (1650-1734). The value rho = ceil(k log W / (2 log q)) and the unequal-width extension (1740-1762) are not given.

The route is the paper's: conjugate by P_M so that kernels act on coordinate slots (1849-1862), implement M by row additions on whole slots (1892-1901), get exactly s_c children on e/m axes with inverse children via C^{-1}=-iZCZ (1885-1890, 1903-1916), and recover H_0^{tensor D} = b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D (1929-1931). L1's phrase 'each of the s_c residual-basis slots' conflates calls with slots: there are m slots, and an edge uses its first rho_edge slots.

The steps follow the proof closely: the eight rotations with cycles (00 01 10), (01 10 11), one cyclic shift per line, the bad set where a guard leaves [10, 2^{K-1}-11], the fraction 80(f-1)2^{-K}, stable radix-sort repair, the top position by a two-bit XOR, and the application to a change of basis at O(V((eK)^tau+1)) (2013-2231). The statement replaces the explicit cost O(V(L^tau+1)+MA^3+delta_bad MA(R+A)) with 'negligible repair terms' and omits the family conditions that make them o(V).

The node overhead, the s children of volume V/W, the rows from the first q_0 chunks padded to W^{k_0} with u=Wg+w, the recurrence F(e) <= (s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}) are all present (2286-2333, 2407, 2432-2445). Missing are the leaf cutoff e<d^beta with F=O(e), the step K <= e^{c/beta} under tau(1+c/beta) < lambda, and the leaf contribution O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}) behind the condition lambda' > sigma+beta(1-sigma) (2403-2430). L2.3 wrongly says the recurrence sums to O(e^lambda).

L states the O(Vd^{lambda'}) layer on one bit per chunk with one final truncation. L3 gives Delta = ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) from A(e) <= sA(e/m)+E, p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits, and epsilon C_1 < 1 giving Delta = o(p) (2457-2586). L4.1/L4.2 reproduce the proof, including absolute row sum one and the error sqrt2 2^{-p} (2691-2757). K = floor(d^c) and the admissible lambda' range are not restated.

All parts of the paper's argument appear in the steps: character cancellation by shifting k (2820-2825), decimation in frequency (2832-2845), bit-reversed storage with B_tF_t^- and F_t^+B_t^{-1} (2864-2887), grouped rounds with J_E (2895-2914), the prefix and chunk-exchange layout L (3002-3032), one layer call per round, the monomial by split and merge, and truncation commuting with J_E (3103-3178). The exact counterparts LBF^-, F^+B^{-1}L^{-1} appear only as the 'LB order' of H5.

The plan uses evaluation at B_0 = 2^{4p}, four products by the established multiplier, centred residues using |h_j| < B_0/2, negacyclic wrap and truncation at O(rp log(rp)), as in 3233-3367. The returned value Q_p(fg/r) is only implied by 'truncating'.

The error sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p} and the cost match Prop. prop:synthetic-convolution. The route matches 3414-3473: forward transforms in the retained LB order, pointwise products commuting with the record permutation, the opposite transform, an exact scale by M, and the error budget 3delta+eta. The normalization identity F^-(f*g) = M(F^-f)(F^-g) (3422-3433) is not spelled out.

The plan has the identity P_sF_s = 2^{2alpha^2} B_0 P_t F_t A with contractions, the error p^2 and the time O(tp^{3/2+delta}alpha). Its derivation follows 3577-3662 (S, T, C, D, ||N-I|| < 1/2, left inverse D N^{-1} C), and the tensor form and costs follow 3836-3896. The retained permutations (P_s u)_j = u_{tj} and (P_t v)_k = v_{-sk}, which are the point of the lemma, are named but never defined.

The plan states both identities QF_t u = conj(a).(a*(conj(a).u))/T and (RF_s^+)[(RF_s u).(RF_s v)] = (u*v)/S^2, and that conjugation gives RF_s^+. The proofs match 3939-3987: the coefficient comparison, F^+R_c = R_c^{-1}F^+ by substituting h=ck, and the two normalizations.

All the fixed rationals, b, p, d, K, T, t_i, Tp = Theta(n), alpha and gamma = o(b) are given correctly (4007-4101). The prime intervals, more than d primes once log x > 8d, gcd = 1, T/2 < S < T and trial division in n^{o(1)} follow 4110-4171. But eta = 1/(4d) is never given, and the resampling hypothesis alpha^4 theta_i > p (4149) is reduced to 'separation > eta'.

The plan states Phi: x -> prod x_i^{mu_i} with mu_i = P_i^{-1} mod s_i as a convolution-preserving isomorphism, implemented by prefix-controlled cyclic shifts with targets updated from i=d down to 1 and O(d^2) chunk swaps, at cost O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)) (4210-4292). The explicit triangular formula b_i = a_i + mu_i sum_{j<i} a_j P_j is only paraphrased as 'depends only on lower-index digits'.

The plan gives x_d -> zeta y with zeta = e^{pi i/r}, well-definedness, the diagonal twist and the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h = zeta^j (4303-4320), and A6.1 has the computed twist / ring convolution / untwist with twist errors 2*2^{-p} (4374-4392). The linewise formula M_C = D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g) is only paraphrased.

The source transform (expand by A, chirp transform, compress by B_0, scale by 2^gamma, exact counterpart RF_s, opposite sign by conjugation) matches 4456-4484. The six-step algorithm and the role of the two occurrences of S match 4506-4544. The digit scaling 2^{-b-2} is omitted.

The plan follows the paper's error chain: contraction and bilinear propagation, E_s = 9*2^gamma TL, G(U.V_1) = (u*v)/S^2 within (3E_s+2)h_p, the final bound 448b 2^{-b+gamma} <= 448b 2^{-3b/4} < 1/2, and carries with the stated invariant (4557-4790). E_ring < 5TL and E_w = S(3E_s+2) < 28*2^gamma T^2 L are not displayed.

K/K3/K5/K6 give the structure: divide by Tp, seven margins with minimum g_2 = 2^{-181} = 2 kappa, log factors <= p^kappa, and a schoolbook cutoff (4851-4995). But the seven normalized costs of Table tab:costs and the margin formulas are never written. In particular g_2 = epsilon c (1-tau), which ties kappa to tau, is missing, and the o(V) bounds for setup and exceptional sorting (4913-4981) are absent.
R only lists 'nlogn-conjecture' among its dependencies and motivates with the n log n scan cost. No step gives the liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n) = 0 argument of 379-387.

errors.says: Method: edge differences are projections onto residuals, whose rank is the dimension change.
errors.paper: This holds for nested labels, but the N source edges of the X_a are exceptions: the first edge matrix is 2P_{U_a}, of rank one, where the dimension change was zero. This is why s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b rather than W_b m - 2N + 2L_b (1158-1166).

errors.says: The phase frames are i^{wt(P_U x) mod 4}, and each edge's frame change is a product of translation kernels aI+bX_v.
errors.paper: The frame is C_U = H^{tensor m} diag_x(i^{q_U(x)}) H^{tensor m} (1193). Only after this Hadamard conjugation does the diagonal character (-1)^{v.x} become the translation X_v (1254-1257). A purely diagonal phase frame would give diagonal edge changes, not translation kernels.

errors.says: Apply the f-fold forward child on each of the s_c residual-basis slots.
errors.paper: A group has m slots. On an edge with residual dimension rho_edge, one child is applied to each of the first rho_edge slots (1879-1882). s_c counts the child calls over the whole network, not slots (1904-1906).

errors.says: With exponents chosen so that a = s/W < m^lambda, the recurrence F(e) <= (s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) sums to O(e^lambda).
errors.paper: Only the internal costs sum to O(e^lambda), and only after using K <= e^{c/beta} and tau(1+c/beta) < lambda. The leaves e < d^beta cost F = O(e) and contribute O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), which is why lambda' must exceed sigma+beta(1-sigma) (2403-2430, 2436-2445).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound: the scalar exchange network, frames, labels and the two interfaces (N) feed the O(Vu^tau) chunk swap (C1, with the matrix shear and the recurrence fully shown) and the O(Vd^lambda') butterfly layer (L). These feed the synthetic transforms and convolution (H), resampling with chirp and permutation cancellation (G3), the algorithm (A), exact recovery (E) and the cost table (K). It thins out where the saving is counted. The label budget Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich is never written, and the N rank-one source-edge exceptions that turn -2N into -N are missing, so s_b < W_b m is asserted (N4.1) rather than derived. The layer recurrence omits the leaf term behind lambda', and K lists no table entries and no margin formula g_2 = epsilon c(1-tau).

steps.note: N1 has the fixed linear network exchanging the banks, (X_a,Y_a) -> (-Y_a,X_a), and restoring every scratch wire. But h=100, the indexing of X_a, Y_a by triples, N = binom(h,3)^3 and m = h^3 are never given; N3 only alludes to triple indicators in an m-dimensional F^{tensor 3}. Since most of the required quantities are missing, I chose the conservative verdict.
N2 states that a common frame commutes with a pointwise gate, so the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, each edge costs the change D_vD_u^{-1}, and only endpoint frames matter (804-825).
N3/N3.1 give nondegenerate subspace labels in the m-dimensional F^{tensor 3}, every edge joining comparable labels, and the central wires 3->4 as the only decreasing edges, each losing h (997-1000).

N4's method has the main mechanism: edge differences are projections onto residuals, with rank equal to the dimension change (1158-1161). It omits the required exception, the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one at zero dimension change (1162-1166), and stated as is it would give the wrong count. Hence the conservative verdict.
N4.1's deficit N-2L_b is equivalent to s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b. But the budget sum |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L and L=Ich never appear: N3 says only 'below W m', so the budget itself is not reconstructed.
N3.2 gives L_b/N = 100/539 and L_c/N = 101/539 < 1/2, leaving a strict saving once the extra source ranks are counted. N4.1 gives the deficit N-2L_b > 0, so s_b < W_b m, and N5 gives s_c < W_c m.
N4/N4.2 state M_sink(rho(w)) - M_source(w) = I_m on every role, including P_{U_a^perp} - (-P_{U_a}) = I_m. C1.1.a draws the consequence: H <- H+D on every row.
The plan factors A = E_1 Pi E_2 with exactly a ones and gives the shear at exactly a interchanges plus O(V). C1.1's motivation and C1.1.4 then make the node issue s recursive calls in total (1543).

The plan has children of volume V/W, F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W < m^tau with tau = 1-2^{-50} from deficits > 20*2^{-50} (N6), and the solution F_k = O(e^tau). The log m < 20 step (1332-1338) is left implicit.

central.summary: The plan carries most of the chain from the fixed network to e^tau. Frames, labels with the single decreasing edge type, L/N < 1/2, the endpoint identity, edges as rank-many recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau = 1-2^{-50} are all reconstructed. It is weakest in the middle of the count. The paper's parameters (h=100, N, m=h^3) are absent; rank equals dimension change is stated without the N rank-one source-edge exceptions; and the budget Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich is never written. So the identity s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b appears only as an asserted deficit.
